decisions.reason: The optional SDA/SCL series-resistor policy and updated cable-length assumption do not change the existing interboard connector selection or signal pinout.
The source concerns I2C signal conditioning and does not change the interboard power connector or its pin-order rule.
The source changes passive conditioning on SDA/SCL but does not reassign SCL0 or any other ESP32-S3 GPIO.
I2C series resistors, pull-ups, and interboard cable length do not affect the retained USB D+ and D- programming interface.
The charge-status resistor and LED circuitry are unrelated to the SDA/SCL series-resistor population policy.
Although the standalone 3.3V rail powers I2C devices, the source does not change the regulator, activation condition, powered loads, or source selection.
The SDA/SCL damping-resistor decision does not affect addressable LED supply voltage, level shifting, or 5V rail control.
The source does not change clock rates, sleep policy, deep-sleep conditions, or wake sources.
The I2C conditioning decision does not change the separate LED board or its addressable LED count.
The sensor board remains a connector hub; the source only changes conditioning of its I2C lines and does not alter the board-role requirement.
Allowing the SDA/SCL resistors to be retained or omitted for layout reasons does not change the component sourceability policy.
The source does not change the AXP2101 selection, system rails, normal-operation power source, or battery power path.
